mtd.mo_ta: Doanh số tháng này đến hôm nay (MTD) + cùng kỳ tháng trước
mtd.sql: WITH d AS (SELECT date, gmv_success, net_revenue_success, count_order_success, count_order_return FROM `surya-495408.01_hptl_report.hptl_pnl_dashboard` WHERE brand_id='HPTH' AND date >= DATE_SUB(DATE_TRUNC(CURRENT_DATE('Asia/Bangkok'), MONTH), INTERVAL 1 MONTH)) SELECT CASE WHEN date >= DATE_TRUNC(CURRENT_DATE('Asia/Bangkok'), MONTH) THEN 'thang_nay' ELSE 'thang_truoc_cung_ky' END AS ky, ROUND(SUM(gmv_success)/1e6,1) AS gmv_trieu_vnd, ROUND(SUM(net_revenue_success)/1e6,1) AS dt_thuan_trieu_vnd, CAST(SUM(count_order_success) AS INT64) AS don, MAX(date) AS den_ngay FROM d WHERE date <= CURRENT_DATE('Asia/Bangkok') AND EXTRACT(DAY FROM date) <= EXTRACT(DAY FROM CURRENT_DATE('Asia/Bangkok')) GROUP BY ky ORDER BY ky DESC

theo_ngay.mo_ta: Doanh số 14 ngày gần nhất, theo ngày
theo_ngay.sql: SELECT date AS ngay, ROUND(SUM(gmv_success)/1e6,1) AS gmv_trieu_vnd, ROUND(SUM(net_revenue_success)/1e6,1) AS dt_thuan_trieu_vnd, CAST(SUM(count_order_success) AS INT64) AS don FROM `surya-495408.01_hptl_report.hptl_pnl_dashboard` WHERE brand_id='HPTH' AND date >= DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE('Asia/Bangkok'), INTERVAL 14 DAY) GROUP BY ngay ORDER BY ngay DESC

theo_kenh.mo_ta: Doanh số MTD chia theo kênh bán
theo_kenh.sql: SELECT channel_key AS kenh, ROUND(SUM(gmv_success)/1e6,1) AS gmv_trieu_vnd, ROUND(SUM(net_revenue_success)/1e6,1) AS dt_thuan_trieu_vnd, CAST(SUM(count_order_success) AS INT64) AS don FROM `surya-495408.01_hptl_report.hptl_pnl_dashboard` WHERE brand_id='HPTH' AND date >= DATE_TRUNC(CURRENT_DATE('Asia/Bangkok'), MONTH) GROUP BY kenh ORDER BY gmv_trieu_vnd DESC
